components.name: Clinical Field
components.description: Warm paper field for professional and clinical data.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: #52635B; font-family: 'Source Sans 3', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-field { height: 48px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #D8D2C7; border-radius: 10px; background: #FBFAF7; color: #20312B; font: 600 14px 'Source Sans 3', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-field:hover { border-color: #276B61; } .ds-field:focus-visible { border-color: #276B61; outline: 3px solid #276B61; }

components.name: Confirmed Status
components.description: Textual status capsule for a confirmed appointment or completed safe state.
components.css: .ds-status-confirmed { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 112px; height: 28px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 14px; background: #DCEBE6; color: #276B61; font-family: 'Source Sans 3', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Clinical Card
components.description: Flat paper plane for immediate clinical context and the next action.

narrative.overview:
O sistema visual trata o dia da clínica como um percurso conectado de cuidado. O próximo atendimento, a decisão pendente e sua consequência aparecem em planos claros, tabelas e sequências cronológicas, sem transformar a rotina da fisioterapeuta em um painel empresarial genérico.

A atmosfera combina um espaço creme quente com planos brancos, tipografia direta e uma rota verde usada como estrutura de informação. A expressão permanece calma e compacta: curvas e nós só aparecem quando comunicam tempo, progresso, seleção ou relação clínica.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream workspace with calm white content planes.
One green care path connecting current state, progress, and next action.
Compact rectangular controls and textual status labels.
Flat tonal layering without gradients or decorative shadows.
Responsive continuity from an icon-and-label desktop sidebar to an icon-and-label mobile bottom navigation.

rules.name: The Green Is Direction Rule
rules.body: Reserve green for primary actions, current navigation, progress, selection, and confirmed states.

rules.name: The Status Has a Voice Rule
rules.body: Every status includes text or a meaningful symbol in addition to color.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Use Source Sans 3 throughout the product and create hierarchy with the established size and weight range.

rules.name: The Tonal Plane Rule
rules.body: Establish hierarchy with background tone and borders; do not add ornamental elevation.

dos: Do keep the next useful action visible beside its clinical context.
Do reserve the care path for chronology, selection, progress, or relationship.
Do pair every semantic color with text or a meaningful symbol.
Do preserve the warm cream workspace, white planes, and restrained green emphasis.
Do collapse the desktop sidebar into icon-and-label bottom navigation on narrow mobile surfaces.
donts: Don't turn the interface into a matrix of equal, disconnected dashboard cards.
Don't use route lines or nodes as decoration without encoded meaning.
Don't add shadows or gradients to create hierarchy that tone and borders already provide.
Don't communicate appointment, message, or clinical status through color alone.
Don't use ambiguous icon-only navigation or mix unrelated functions without group labels.
